sections.text: An ad is only worth as much as *the page it lands on.*
prose: Many companies raise their ad budget when the real problem lies after the click: a vague message, a slow page, a painful form. The cost per customer climbs, and the platform gets the blame.
That's our strength: upstream (offer and message) and downstream (page, funnel, measurement). The media experts in our network run the campaigns; we make sure the traffic they win actually converts.

items.p: Who are you targeting, with what promise and on which channel? We craft an offer that's hard to ignore before spending a dollar.
[Landing pages](@landing-pages) and funnels designed for each campaign, consistent with the ad's message.
Setup and coordination with the media expert from our network: Google Ads, Meta (Facebook and Instagram), LinkedIn and other relevant platforms.
Conversion and event tracking setup, so you know which ads truly bring in customers.
Testing of messages, visuals and pages based on data, to lower acquisition cost over time.
Indicators that speak business — inquiries, cost per inquiry, customers — rather than mere impressions.

sections.p: Let's review your funnel and find where your budget leaks.

faq.q: Do you run the ad campaigns yourselves?
a: We orchestrate strategy, pages and tracking, and work with selected media experts from our network to run the campaigns. You get a single point of contact and specialists for each platform.

faq.q: What ad budget should I plan for?
a: There's no universal figure: it depends on your market, your offer and your goals. Our pages have generated up to a 3,500% increase in inquiries with minimal budgets. We set a realistic starting budget during the diagnosis.

faq.q: Which platforms do you advertise on?
a: We choose based on where your ideal customers are: Google Ads for search intent, Meta for discovery, LinkedIn for B2B, among others.

faq.q: Why is the landing page as important as the ad?
a: The ad earns the click; the page earns the inquiry. If the page is vague, slow or inconsistent with the ad's promise, cost per customer rises even with an excellent campaign.

faq.q: How do I measure return on investment?
a: We set up conversion tracking from the start to tie each ad to inquiries and customers, then compare acquisition cost to the value of a customer.
